conditions: Message is posted in the channel #incidents.
Message content concerns a payment gateway outage (it is the message reporting/discussing that outage).
Diego Alvarez (the specific person) has reacted to that message with a :fire: emoji reaction.
The requested action is to add a :rocket: reaction to that same message.

readings: There is exactly one message about the payment gateway outage in #incidents, so 'the message' picks it out directly.

There are multiple messages about the outage (initial alert, updates, resolution), and only the fire-reaction-by-Diego condition narrows it to one specific message — if Diego fire-reacted to more than one, the reference is ambiguous.
Could include a thread reply to a message about the outage.
Some other fire-themed emoji variant (e.g., :fire_engine:), though this is a minor/unlikely reading.
